_comment: Data-driven bottom panel. `launchers` are freedesktop desktop-ids (resolved as applications:<id>.desktop) pinned in the icon-tasks widget, in order. `pager_names` name the 4 virtual desktops. The system-monitor widget sensor IDs live in bottom-panel.nix (they are fixed KSystemStats identifiers, not project data). PSI (pressure) is intentionally absent — KSystemStats exposes no /proc/pressure sensor; PSI lives in Cloud-Terminal → System Performance.
